notes.title: Update Ver1.02（2021/06/22 ）
notes.notes:
The following updates have been applied.
---------------------------------------------------------------
・Adjusted Palmyra of Genesis to get stronger proportionately to the number of times she is defeated.
・Other minor adjustments and fixes.

notes.title: Update Ver1.01（2021/05/17 ）
notes.notes:
The following updates have been applied.
---------------------------------------------------------------
Adjusted frame rate specifications.
Fixed an issue that caused the game to crash when attempting to view the "High-speed Levitation" effect for Toydozer in the Encyclopedia.
Added a warning message regarding accessing the photo mode when you play as you download.
Other minor adjustments and fixes.
